# Autodesk Data Management

`autodesk-aps-data-management` · openapi · version `1.0` · **published** · readiness `reviewed_publication_user_test_required`

Connect an Autodesk account with an independent Ragentic integration: hubs, projects, folders, items and versions of files in Fusion Team, Autodesk Docs and ACC. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Autodesk.
